newsitem.title: USA: Compaq, Thomson unit unveil PC/TV system.
newsitem.headline: Compaq, Thomson unit unveil PC/TV system.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp on Monday unveiled its "PC Theatre" product, a personal computer combined with a big-screen television.
Developed with Thomson SA's Thomson Consumer Electronics, the PC Theatre integrates a 36-inch screen display from Thomson's RCA television brand with a Compaq multimedia PC and wireless keyboard.
Compaq said the product will allow consumers to watch television on the same box they use to play computer games and use the Internet.
The product is priced at $4,999 and will be jointly marketed with both the RCA and Compaq brand names on it.
It will be available in May in six U.S. markets, with national distribution planned for autumn, Compaq said.
